raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The two `SchedulerProfilerManager` MPS tests mock
`mx.metal.start_capture`/`stop_capture`, but the patched profiler takes the MPS
path and calls `torch.mps.profiler.metal_capture`. The success test can
therefore start a real Metal capture and fail unless `MTL_CAPTURE_ENABLED` is
set, while the failure test can pass for the wrong reason.

Fixes #30550.

## Modifications

- Force both manager tests to select the MPS path even when the MLX CI lane
  exports `SGLANG_USE_MLX=1`.
- Mock the actual `torch.mps.profiler.metal_capture` call.
- Verify that the successful capture context is entered and exited.

## Accuracy Tests

N/A - test-only change; no model or runtime behavior is changed.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A.

## Validation

- `python -m py_compile test/registered/unit/hardware_backend/mlx/test_metal_profiler.py`
- `uvx --from isort==7.0.0 isort --check-only --diff test/registered/unit/hardware_backend/mlx/test_metal_profiler.py`
- `uvx --from ruff==0.15.1 ruff check --select=F401,F821,UP037 test/registered/unit/hardware_backend/mlx/test_metal_profiler.py`
- `uvx --from black==26.1.0 black --check test/registered/unit/hardware_backend/mlx/test_metal_profiler.py`
- `git diff --check`

The target MLX unit test was not run locally because this host is not Apple
Silicon. The `stage-a-unit-test-mlx` lane on `macos-26` is the authoritative
runtime check.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the Format code with pre-commit guidance.
- [x] Add or update unit tests according to the unit test guidance.

nodes.body:
> [!WARNING]
> You have reached your daily quota limit. Please wait up to 24 hours and I will start processing your requests again!

Thanks for the fix — I confirmed the root cause and verified it on real Apple Silicon (the PR notes it couldn't be run locally).

**Environment:** M2 Max 64GB, macOS, mlx 0.32.0, mlx-lm 0.31.3, torch 2.11.0, transformers 5.12.1.

**Root cause (code-level).** `SchedulerProfilerManager._start_profile` (`profiler_manager.py:166`) maps the default `activities=["CPU","GPU"]` to `[ProfilerActivity.CPU, ProfilerActivity.CUDA]`. With `SGLANG_USE_MLX` unset, `use_mlx()` is `False`, so the patched `torch.profiler.profile` (`profiler.py:163`) takes the MPS branch → `MetalCaptureProfiler.start_mps` → `torch.mps.profiler.metal_capture`. The original test mocked `mx.metal.start_capture` (the MLX-path object), which is never called on this path, so the success case hit a real Metal capture failing without `MTL_CAPTURE_ENABLED`, and the failure case passed for the wrong reason. Mocking `torch.mps.profiler.metal_capture` and pinning `use_mlx`→`False` as this PR does is exactly right.

**Verification (current main `db9143e` → this PR applied):**
- Before: `TestSchedulerProfilerManagerMPS::test_start_profile_success_with_mock_capture` FAILED (`AssertionError: False is not true`); the other 9 in the file pass.
- After: `10 passed in 4.72s`.

The remaining CI jobs are the call-gate / `-finish` jobs rather than a test failure. Happy to help with a rebase onto current main or anything else to move this forward.

Heads-up: the substance of this change appears to have landed on main via #34300 (and follow-up formatting in #37210), so this PR is likely superseded — sharing verification data in case it helps close it out.

On current `main` (`febb360`, Apple Silicon M4 Max), `TestSchedulerProfilerManagerMPS` now pins `use_mlx` at its point of use in `profiler.py` (setUp-level patch, which also handles the cached-value case the ambient environment can't override) and mocks `torch.mps.profiler.metal_capture` for both the failure and success paths — the same MPS-strategy mocking this PR introduced. Full file for me: **10 passed, 3 warnings in 13.65s**, including `test_start_profile_success_with_mock_capture`, which fails on pre-#34300 main under the same conditions this PR describes.

So the underlying issue (#30550) is resolved on main. Suggest closing as superseded by #34300 unless there's a residual piece I'm missing — happy to be corrected.

Thanks @zxyasfas! I'm fairly sure this is already covered on main - #34300 fixed the SchedulerProfilerManager MPS capture mocks (plus a formatting pass in #37210), and `TestSchedulerProfilerManagerMPS` passes on current main. Closing as superseded; please reopen if I've missed a case.
